summary: Actual teacher upvote, upvote-sort, open-detail, downvote correction, back, and index upvote correction all work in volatile synthetic fixtures. The vote API reports the correct voted state and count changes; however the pure rendered detail tree shows only the upvote count and no current-vote text/pressed state or downvote count, and the index upvote control has no pressed state. Evidence supports a bounded projection-only feedback enhancement, not a vote math/sort/navigation defect. No product edit or Git mutation was made.
proposed_smallest_correction: Renderer-only teacher vote-state feedback: index upvote aria-pressed as string true/false; detail text for no vote/upvote/downvote plus matching aria-pressed string true/false on both arrows. Preserve aggregate count, existing sort semantics, and anonymous/moderator controls; do not change controller, vote mutation, storage, services, or authority.
